method: Reread the 2026–2027 TER credit tables and project rule and checked the individual course entries and scheme blocks before checking the exact frozen comparison against workbook evidence and interests.
findings: The regulations list two 40 EC specialisations and the public description identifies neither as the default. The first-listed Production Technology and Logistics route has 60 EC common first year, 30 upper common, 40 specialisation, 30 approved minor space and a 20 EC final project. Dated term entries place Design of Complex Systems in year two and give 150 EC through the minor before the final spring. The stricter formal condition is 140 completed IEM EC with the entire first year and one accepted design-methods course. Expected prior knowledge in the catalogue does not add compulsory minor credits.

The first UCR option has substantive economics, business and organisational inquiry combined with optimisation, kinematics and signal processing. Linear Algebra precedes Linear Systems and Robotics, and data preparation precedes statistical learning. The second has a sustained energy and resources sequence through life-cycle assessment, recovery laboratory work, geochemistry and renewable design. Energy & Sustainability develops the preparatory technical-economic context. Thirteen different courses each way support substantive distinctness.

Rechecked the strongest alignments from source content. Linear Systems and Signals and Systems share continuous and discrete representations and filtering. Operations Research and Optimization Methods in AI overlap in constrained modelling and linear programming. The selected robotics and design courses cover practical motion planning and consumer prototyping without the specialist production and mechanical sequence. Optional independent research remains outside the scheduled total alongside the Integration Project.

The caution view uses the programme and route, both UCR concepts, the disciplinary scope note and five verified note references. Reviewed all 27 external titles, 37 selected UCR titles and description texts, all rows and both schedules, and the official links.
